description: The Gotthard Pass summit, about 2106 m, lies in the municipality of Airolo in Ticino, roughly two kilometres south of the border with Uri. Lago della Piazza sits on the barren saddle, with the low hospice and museum just south of the water and the old Tremola cobbles leaving the pass. Late September at this height is rock and tawny grass, with only residual snow in shaded gullies. The frame is the pass rather than Andermatt or the Schöllenen gorge, under a partly cloudy, windy, and cool Open-Meteo model with no precipitation.
